book.name: Hechos
book.title: Hechos de los Apóstoles L̇l̇ëbo shäryara Sbö tjl̈õkwo roy l̈agaga Jesús ãskarë

content: Pablo to shäng Macedonia kjokyo, Grecia kjokyo
Nopga shdöktong kës l̈i sl̈ano pjir ga Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga rokara Pablorë, poshdũya wl̈o. Poshduna pjir ga «Tja toe» l̈e, ga to jek Macedonia kjokyo.
Öötong shäng eshko ga jek shäng Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng l̈i dbo ië kjok kjrinashko kjrinashko. E irgo ga to jek öötong shäng Grecia kjokyo,

ga beno sök eshko mogl̈o mya. E irgo ga opshik to jongya Siria kjokyo l̈e. Brikdo, opyë kjyong kësbang roy l̈arashko ga roy kuya ga judíoga wotjl̈ĩk ba zrök l̈e l̈ëba. E kjĩshko ga wotjl̈ĩk to iröng pjö l̈ëkong Macedonia kjokyo go shara l̈e.
Ba yorkagaga jek l̈öng ba tjok l̈i ëre: Sópater, e Pirro wa, Pirro, e Berea so; Aristarco, Segundo, epga Tesalónica so; Gayo, e Derbe so; Tíquico, Trófimo, epga Asia so; Timoteo bakoe.
Epga uunkong jek l̈öng borwa bäm go, ga tjawa koshe öötong l̈öng Troas kjokyo. Gueniyo tjawa beno l̈öng Pablo tjok.

Tjawa beno l̈öng Filipos kjokyo äär jong pjl̈ung shosho suk pjir shäryak ba uukkl̈o tjok l̇l̇ëm dbaryo l̈i pjitong guing. E irgo ga tjawa opshino jek Filipos kjokyo dwayo äär jong dl̈ung kjako, ga tjawa opyono kjyong kësbang roy, ga tjawa jeke. Öötong dbargwo shkëng (5) ga epga dosharorwa öötong l̈öng Troas kjokyo. Ga tjawa beno l̈öng eshko dbargwo kjäk (7).
Dwl̈as wol̈ono kjl̈ara, ga woshrara Pablorë iröng obi

Öötong dbar sondëshko ga tjawa töno Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga tjok, ië wl̈o. Ga Pablo tjl̈ẽno nopga l̈öng l̈i kong. Ga opshik eshko dwayo wẽshko l̈e kjĩshko ga beno shäng tjl̈ẽ wop ara äär jong kjok ronge.

Ga tjawa töno l̈öng l̈ishko ga yongyo shäryak jem jong ëng kopshko l̇l̇ögong l̇l̇ögong äär jong kjringgwo myashko, tjawa l̈öng l̈i ey. Eshko ga iök borkek l̈ok shjiy arae. Ga dwl̈as shäng kjl̈ara eshko ko Eutico, ga sirkeno sök u bäng bäng go. Eshko ga Pablo tjl̈ẽ shäng kjër wopro ga Eutico sök ga poywõ ara. Wop ara ga pono, ga l̈ono jer jong kjokshko dwayo äär jong töshko, ga wol̈onoe.
Eni ga Pablo opl̈ono jer ba ĩk, ga opburgö dwl̈as l̈i kjing go, ga popjl̈ura. Eshko ga tjl̈ẽ nopga l̈öng l̈i kong ga «Pjãy woydë l̇l̇ëme. ¡Buk së!» l̈e.
E irgo ga Pablo jem kjomo iröng obi, ga pjl̈ung shosho suk pjir shdöra, ga uara tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng l̈i tjok, ga beno shäng tjl̈õkwo l̈ë ba kong obi äär jong kjok shränto. E irgo ga toe.
E irgo ga dwl̈as l̈ira söra l̈ok jek ba ushko së. E kjĩshko ga ba pjeyoga beno l̈öng wopjl̈ú anmoyõ.
Pablo tjl̈õkwo l̈ono tjl̈apgaga Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjraga kägäyo l̈öng Éfeso kjokyo l̈i kong
E irgo ga Pablo beno shäng Troas kjokyo obi, ga tjawara opshino jek ba bäm go, tjwe jong Asón kjokyo kjyong kësbang go. Woyde Pablorë ga jek pjö l̈ëkong, ga koshërwa l̈öng eshko.
Eni ga Pablo tjwe shäng eshko, ga töno borwa tjok, ga opyono jek shäng kjyong kësbang roy borwa tjok. Eni ga tjawa jek äär l̈öng Mitilene kjokyo.

Wẽshko ga tjawa opshino eshko dwayo, ga tjawa jek l̈öng Quío kjokyo, e bokshto. Wẽshko ga tjawa jek äär l̈öng Samos kjokyo. Woyde Pablorë ga tjawa sl̈an ber l̈öng Éfeso kjokyo l̇l̇ëme l̈e, äär Jerusalén kjokyo judío dbar shrëzl̈ong dbaryo kowe l̈ok Pentecostés l̈i bäm go wl̈o. E kjĩshko ga wẽshko ga tjawa öötong l̈öng Mileto kjokyo.
Eshko ga no ichara Pablorë tjl̈apgaga Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjraga kägäyo l̈öng Éfeso kjokyo l̈i rokë.
Eni ga öötong l̈öngshko ga Pablo tjl̈ẽ ba kong ga «Dënashko ga tja tek shrono shäng Asia kjokyo ëreshko ga tja beno shäng bomi tjok dbar kop ara. L̇l̇ëye shäryoror eshko l̈i miydëmi pjir tjän.

Eshkoshko ga judíoga kjong kjong opyono beno l̈öng bor wl̈oyo. E kjĩshko ga l̇l̇ëbo weno bor kong owa ara, ga tja beno shäng woydë ara bakoe. Gueniyo tja beno shäng parkë Tjl̈apga Jesús kong wotöy ĩyadoe.
Tja Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈ono oba uunkong bokshto, ga pjãy pinor öör bomi ushko bakoe. Eshko ga tjl̈õkwo l̇l̇ë ber pjl̈ú bomi kong wl̈o l̈i, e l̈oror bomi kong pjir, l̇l̇ëye bangkjrër l̇l̇ëm wl̈eni.

Eshko ga tja tjl̈ẽno shäng tjl̈õkwo kjwaraso judíoga kong, nopga judío l̇l̇ëm wl̈eniyo kong bakoe. Tja tjl̈ẽ ga “L̇l̇ëbo owa shäryëmi l̈öng l̈i, e owa jl̈õe l̈ozĩ, ga rayozĩ, ga pjãy optwos Sbö kong dey, ga pjãy mär ber l̈öng bi Tjl̈apga Jesús go” l̈ër shäng eni ĩyado.
»Ga eerishko ga tja jongya Jerusalén kjokyo, tja iche Sbö Sëyarë jek eshko kjĩshko. Gueniyo l̇l̇ëye wen bor kong eshko l̈i miydër shäng l̇l̇ëme.

Miydër shäng l̈i, e kjrinaso. Tja to shäng kjok shto obl̈ë obl̈ë l̈ishko ga Sbö Sëya tjl̈ẽ bor kong ga “L̇l̇ono ga pja iëba ber shäng no shdũzl̈ong uyo roshko, ga l̇l̇ëbo wen obl̈ë obl̈ë bop kong bakoe” l̈e bor kong eni.

Gueniyo bor kong ga tja wol̈onde, de l̇l̇ëm, e l̇l̇ëye l̇l̇ëme. Woydër l̈i, e kjrinaso. Pak twara Tjl̈apga Jesúsdë bor kong shäryër wl̈o l̈e l̈i, tja wol̈onoshko ga e shäryoror pjire. Ga pak l̈i, e shji kjimte woydë Sbörë sorë l̈i roy pjl̈ú shdör oba kong.
»Ga pjãy kong Sbö ber no pjl̈uyo sorë l̈i roy l̈oror bomi kong ara. Gueniyo l̈ër bomi kong ga tja ĩmi ame.
L̇l̇ëye woyde Sbörë l̈i, e l̈oror bomi kong dret, l̇l̇ëye bangkjrër l̇l̇ëm wl̈eni. E kjĩshko ga l̈ër bomi kong ga pjãy miydaga ber tjarë ame.

Sbö tjl̈õkwo kjragaga tjwl̈ẽna ba Wa srëng l̈i go pjir, ga pjãy iara ba Sëyarë beno l̈öng ba dë. E kjĩshko ga pjãy wl̈ẽp l̇l̇ëme. Pjãy opdos yõtso. Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga dëmi, öng wl̈ẽp ushko so de ba dagarë wl̈eni.

»Miydër pjl̈ú ga tja opshino kjok jũshko dwayoshko ga domerga owa tjwe opzrëk bomi tjrëko ara, ga Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga l̈öng l̈i barwe ara, shjiti kjl̈oy so iir ä wl̈eniyo tjwe öng l̇l̇ë uë wl̈eni.
Ga kjone kjone l̈öng bomi tjrëko ëmdë ga opyë l̈öng jyõrkë, ga Sbö tjl̈õkwo l̈e l̈ok bomi kong bëy l̇l̇ëm, Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjragaga jyãpgwe jek ba shwo l̈ëkong wl̈o l̈e.
E kjĩshko ga pjãy sjëke. Woyoshrozĩ ga l̈u pjl̈ogl̈o mya ga pjãy poshdunor boryo go shkë dba, pjãy kjl̈arashko kjl̈arashko.

»Era eni, pjeyoga, eerishko ga pjãy iër ber tjeng Sbö wl̈oshko, pjãy de wl̈o, ga shji kjimte Sbörë sorë tjl̈õkwoyo l̈i, e ber pjang bomi daga bakoe. Pjãy jëk tjl̈õkwo l̈i go ga pjãy opping ba miydë pjl̈ú jek këgong këgong. Eni ga l̇l̇ëbo pjl̈ú twe ba nopga baĩya kong wl̈o l̈i, e twe bomi kong bakoe.
»Ga l̇l̇ëye oma ĩ, e koĩnor l̇l̇ëm, dbur l̇l̇ëm, shwong l̇l̇ëm bakoe.
Eni l̇l̇ëme. Miydëmi pjl̈ú ga tja parkono bor orkwo om go goshko, l̇l̇ëbo woydër bor kong, bor yorkagaga kong l̈i tjwl̈ẽn wl̈o.

Ga pjãy pinor eni, woyde ga shji parkë eni, obl̈ë l̈öng l̇l̇ëbo woydë l̈i kjimtëy ga pjl̈ú wl̈o. Tjl̈õkwo l̈ara Tjl̈apga Jesúsdë l̈i, e woyoshrozĩa. Tjl̈ẽno ga “L̇l̇ëbo kjroroy ga shji wopjl̈úe. Gueniyo ga l̇l̇ëbo tworoy obl̈ë kong ga shji wopjl̈ú e kjinmo” l̈ara eni» l̈e.
L̈ara eni pjir ga kjök torgö sök Jesús tjl̈õkwo kjraga kägäyoga l̈öng l̈i tjok, ga syõshtono Sbö kong.
Eni ga epga sl̈atong l̈ok uunkong, ga Pablo popjl̈ura uunkong l̈irë, ga l̈õ shira l̈ok bakoe.
Eshko ga Pablo tjl̈ẽno ba kong ga «Tja toe. Tja ĩmi ame» l̈ara ba kong kjĩshko ga epga woydono l̈ok arae. E irgo ga tyara l̈ok öör jek l̈öng kjyong kësbang buk l̈ishko, to wl̈o.

footnotes.text: L̈õ shik l̈anyo, e tak pjang Génesis 27.26 go.
